title: Canon alla Duodecima

captions.text: ☞ Dux: the lower voice leads, alone.
☞ Comes: the upper voice, a twelfth higher, eight bars later.
☞ The roles change: now the upper voice leads.
☞ The lower voice follows two octaves down, eight bars later.

listenFor: canon at the twelfth, eight bars apart; then the parts change places
